plugins.name: perfect-hub
plugins.description: Perfect Hub: an office of specialist agents for Claude Code. /absolute convenes a council - product, architecture, frontend, backend, UI/UX, visual, security, QA, devops, mobile and domain experts propose, tear each other's ideas apart, credit what is genuinely strong and settle on a written decision, then build it behind TDD and review gates. /absolute-goal takes an idea all the way to release. Components: selling, ads, office documents, business (FOP), brand, social, marketing, research, translation and Perfect Antislop.
